mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 above 20,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days despite GDPC1 exceeding 20,000, or positive returns occur when GDPC1 is below 20,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 5.5% per annum signals tighter monetary policy, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.5% but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days, or returns are positive when FEDFUNDS remains below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in RSAFS (demand) above 700,000 millions and INDPRO (supply) above 105 signal balanced growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both RSAFS and INDPRO cross thresholds but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days, or returns are positive when only one crosses.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL crossing above 2% triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days in a regime of sub-trend inflation.
failure_condition: In sub-trend inflation regime, S&P 500 returns are not positive when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2%, or returns are positive when CPIAUCSL stays below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS above 5.0% and PAYEMS above 156,205 thousands signal labor market strength and accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Both proxies rise but S&P 500 returns are negative over 5 days, or returns are positive when only one proxy rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 3.0% signals tight labor markets, prompting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 3.0% but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days, or returns are positive when UNRATE remains above 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeding 105 signals robust supply conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO is above 105 but S&P 500 returns are negative over 5 days, or returns are positive when INDPRO is below 105.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 above 20,000 and PAYEMS above 156,205 thousands signal robust demand and labor strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both proxies rise but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days, or returns are positive when only one proxy rises.
